item.title: The NIGHTCELL 7 trailer, and every model in the build
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: NIGHTCELL 7 is a tactical shooter that runs in a browser. Until today its home page was still images and prose. It now opens with a 26 second gameplay trailer, and further down carries four…

item.title: fleetsysops.com: a manifesto for running a fleet of coding agents
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A fleet is agents. Dozens of them at once, coding, deploying, posting and fixing, on servers they have root on. A sysop is the one human running the fleet. Some call it fleet coding. Today we wrote…

item.title: One key for every Profullstack service
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: One Power Key opens all 54 Profullstack services: Ed25519-signed, verified offline by every site, $299 lifetime, half off with 50OFF, paid through CoinPay.

item.title: d0rz now sells scheduled delivery routes to businesses
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Per-stop pricing for pharmacies, labs, dental and vet practices, law firms, florists and caterers in the SF Bay Area, with proof of delivery on every stop and a two-week pilot.

item.title: OutreachGraph now has an agent API: keys, dollar budgets, an inbox and suppress lists
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: A keyless llms.txt and OpenAPI schema, workspace API keys, daily budgets in dollars that become policy caps, a tabbed inbox with policy-checked replies, hot leads, suppress lists by email or domain, and a lead import.

item.title: profullstack.com now says what we do: agentic engineering
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: profullstack.com stopped calling itself a web development agency. Title, meta, copy, services and skill.md now say agentic engineering: a senior engineer directs a fleet of coding agents, and every change ships through review, tests and CI.

item.title: agenticjobs 0.19.0: register the agents you operate, watch a search, and every search is a page
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: An account registers the agents it operates, with required skills. Watches notify by email, on the board and by browser push. Every search is a path, and rankings on the leaderboard package.

item.title: profullstack.com/stack: the stack, per use case, written for agents
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The current Profullstack stack as eight combos for different jobs, with shared defaults, house rules and the packages to reuse first. Markdown and JSON copies for agents.

item.title: OpenSaaS: the way out of a subscription, written down beside the way in
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: One file a subscription service serves at /.well-known/opensaas.json: plans and eight actions, each as the page a person opens and the endpoint an agent calls with an OpenAccess scope. nichedb.dev serves the first one and reads them.

item.title: The pit signs now: one root for every Moshpit name
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: The Moshpit registry is now a certificate authority: one root, thirty-day certificates per name issued only to whoever controls the name, installed by moshcode and shipped with TronBrowser.
